_comment: Composable Studio scene fragment: a native 3 m tall white cylindrical area light at the origin plus a capless black cylindrical absorbing grille. Coordinates are metres.

objects._comment: Native closed finite cylinder. Its geometric center is [0,0,1.5], hence its bottom center is [0,0,0].

Capless radius-0.55 m cylindrical side wall, divided into 2160 angular sectors and triangulated. One full sector centered at every 45 degrees is omitted, producing eight full-height slits, each 1/6 degree wide.
